programs.title: Happened Schnirch
programs.desc: Brno, the night of May 30-31, 1945. Gerta Schnirch (Barbora Váchová), the daughter of a Nazi and a Czech mother, together with her several-month-old child, is - like almost all Germans - expelled from the city.The exhausting procession, marked by violence and humiliation, later called the death march, ends near the border with Austria.From the temporary camp, Gerta goes to work in the Moravian countryside.She manages to save her own life and that of her daughter.After five years he returns to Brno.No one is waiting for her in the city, but she still can't leave it.She becomes entangled in a vortex of further turbulent changes.A film adaptation of Kateřina Tučková's debut novel, "The Expulsion of Greta Schnirch", touching on the difficult topic of Czech and German guilt, revenge, forgiveness and national identity.

programs.title: L'amica geniale
programs.desc:
Elena Greco is an elderly woman who tries to solve the mystery of the disappearance of her friend - Raffaella Ceruullo, who was called Lila.The women met in their early youth - in 1950, when they attended primary school.The old woman recalls her early years.The action of the series takes place in dangerous and charming Naples and spans 60 years.The story of their relationship is unconventional, because although Lila was Elena's best friend and confidant, she was also her enemy.The series is an adaptation of the novel by Elena Ferrante
Elena notices the changes taking place in her body: she is growing up.She continues her education, but it is not easy for her to obtain satisfactory grades.The girl lacks a friend with whom she could share her fears.However, it is difficult for them to meet because Lila works in a shoe factory that belongs to her father and spends a lot of time there.Even though she finished her education earlier than Elena, she manages to help her friend learn Latin.Thanks to this, she improves her grades and at the end of the year she is the best student in her class.Everything seems to indicate that Elena will be awarded the prize for the most persistent book study, but not everything goes according to plan.The teacher, Mr. Ferraro, decides that Lila will receive the award.

programs.title: French Courier from Liberty, Kansas Evening Sun
programs.desc: The 20th-century fictional French town of Ennui-sur-Blasé is the headquarters of "Kurier Francuski", a magazine published by American emigrants.When a respected editor, Kansas native Arthur Howitzer Jr (Bill Murray), dies, the entire team gathers to write an obituary.Their memories make up four colorful stories.Herbsaint Sazerac (Owen Wilson), an avid cyclist, recalls dark stories related to the city, showing its dangerous alleys.J.K.L.Berensen (Tilda Swinton) presents the story of an insane painter, Moses Rosenthaler (Benicio del Toro), who creates from behind prison bars.A brilliant artist is involved in an affair with a guard and his muse (Lea Seydoux).An art dealer, Julian Cadazio (Adrien Brody), tries to make money from his paintings.Lucinda Krementz (Frances McDormand) tells the story of a fiery student rebellion led by Zeffirelli (Timothée Chalamet).It is also a story of beautiful love and tragic death on the barricades.Roebuck Wright (Jeffrey Wright) presents a story about drugs, kidnappings and refined cuisine, and its hero will be Lieutenant Nescaffier (Steve Park).Another visual masterpiece from Wes Anderson is a tribute to old-style journalism.The elaborate, nostalgic anthology is inspired by the famous weekly "The New Yorker" and the personalities who made up its editorial staff.

programs.title: The Hobbit: An Unexpected Journey
programs.desc: An adventure-filled journey through a magical land begins.A quiet homebody, Bilbo Baggins has spent his entire life in an idyllic hobbit village.To his surprise, the wizard Gandalf offers him a trip to Erebor.The descendants of the dwarves who were deprived of their kingdom by the dragon Smaug, led by Thorin, intend to regain their former power.Gandalf says they need the help of an agile halfling.Bilbo is drawn into a whirlwind of extraordinary events.His team must face the numerous dangers that lurk in Middle-earth.The main role is played by the excellent Martin Freeman.The cast also included Ian McKellen and Richard Armitage.The three-time Oscar-nominated first part of the spectacular film adaptation of the novel "The Hobbit, or There and Back Again" by J.R.R.Tolkien.The action takes place 60 years before the events of "The Lord of the Rings".A real treat for fantasy lovers.

programs.title: First Man
programs.desc: The 1960s, the times of the Cold War.The USA and the USSR are engaged in an arms race.The competition also concerns the conquest of space.Test pilot and astronaut Neil Armstrong leads the pioneering Gemini 8 mission, which marks the first-ever docking of two spacecraft in orbit.The test does not go according to plan, as the daredevils lose control of the connected machines.Their lives hang in the balance.However, Neil demonstrates extraordinary skills and self-control, thanks to which he and his companion, David Scott, successfully return to Earth.A year after the tragedy of the Apollo 1 crew, who died during the launch simulation, Armstrong becomes commander of the Apollo 11 mission. It will go down in history.Its goal is to land a man on the Moon.

programs.title: A Big Bold Beautiful Journey
programs.desc: Sarah (Margot Robbie) and David (Colin Farrell) meet at a friend's wedding.They go on an expedition during which they relive the most important moments from their past.

programs.title: Industry
programs.desc: The further fate of a group of young bankers in Great Britain.Pierpoint, Harper (Myha'la) and Yasmin (Marisa Abela) live the lavish life they dreamed of as graduates.The financiers are drawn into a tense game when a fintech genius appears on the London scene.Yasmin develops a relationship with Sir Henry Muck (Kit Harington), and Harper is drawn into the web of influence of the mysterious director, Whitney Halberstram (Max Minghella).Under the pressure of money and power, the friendship of young women is put to the test.

programs.title: The Last of Us
programs.sub_title: When You're Lost in the Darkness
programs.desc:
Twenty years have passed since the destruction of civilization.Joel Miller (Pedro Pascal) is a battle-hardened survivor.One day, a man is hired to smuggle 14-year-old Ellie (Bella Ramsey) out of the oppressive quarantine zone.What begins as a simple assignment soon becomes a dangerous and heartbreaking journey across the old United States.During this expedition, they both begin to understand that they can only rely on each other to survive.Based on the popular video game of the same title
The year 2003. Joel Miller (Pedro Pascal) is just 36 years old.The man works with his brother Tommy (Gabriel Luna) and raises teenage Sarah (Nico Parker) on his own.Their lives go on at a leisurely pace until the day the media begins to provide information about cases of aggression occurring across the country.All services are put on alert.It quickly turns out to be a rapidly spreading epidemic that turns people into beasts.Joel, Tommy and Sarah try to leave the city because it is full of infected people, but they are prevented from doing so by the military that has taken over.One of the soldiers shoots at them, fatally wounding the teenager.20 years have passed.Boston is a closed quarantine zone.Joel is in a relationship with Tess (Anna Torv).They are smugglers who have deals with soldiers and know how to get outside the walls.Meanwhile, there is a group of so-calledFireflies, which fights against the military dictatorship.She wants to take teenage Ellie (Bella Ramsey) out of town.The girl was infected with a fungus that caused an epidemic three weeks earlier, but she is still healthy.When the Fireflies' plan fails, their leader, Marlene (Merle Dandridge), encourages Joel and Tess to get the girl out of town for a handsome reward.

programs.title: Finding Harry: The Craft Behind The Magic
programs.desc: HBO 3 is the home of acclaimed television series and cult favorites, focusing on immersive storytelling and marathon-worthy drama from the HBO library.

programs.title: Euphoria
programs.desc: The further fate of a group of friends who left school behind and entered adulthood.The action moves forward several years.Rue (Zendaya Coleman) is no longer a lost teenager, but a person involved in the criminal world.He goes to interrogation in connection with smuggling drugs from Mexico.Cassie (Sydney Sweeney) and Maddy's (Alexa Demie) relationship has improved, but old wounds haven't healed at all.The first woman's relationship with Nate (Jacob Elordi) develops, but not towards a happy ending.The remaining characters confront their own choices, addiction and violence.They are looking for redemption and answers to the question about their place in the world.

programs.title: Lord Of The Flies
programs.desc: A film adaptation of William Golding's 1954 novel.A group of British boys on a desert island try to create fair rules.However, fear and power struggles lead to chaos and aggression.

programs.title: Sinners
programs.desc: The year is 1932. Twin brothers Smoke and Stack (double role of Michael B. Jordan), who have a difficult past, return from Chicago to their hometown in Mississippi.They try to escape from problems and a life of crime.They establish a music club for black people and hope for a new beginning.Their enemy, however, are dark, sinister forces that they must face.At stake is not only the lives of the brothers and their loved ones, but also their culture, history and memory.A dark cinema combining elements of action, horror and a musical drawing on the blues tradition.It is a story about an attempt at redemption and the fight against an invisible evil that symbolizes the weight of the past and past sins.
